stories.title: Russia pounds Kyiv region, killing 4 and targeting the power grid
stories.summary: Russia pressed on with its weekslong missile and drone barrage of Kyiv and the surrounding region, killing four people and striking energy infrastructure. The sustained attacks keep Ukrainian civilians and the capital's power supply under pressure.

stories.title: Russian air strikes kill 4, injure 5 around Kyiv
stories.summary: Russian drone and missile attacks on Kyiv and neighboring areas killed four people and injured five, damaging energy infrastructure. Officials said an overnight strike also hit a communications centre.

stories.title: US military says withdrawal of troops from Iraq is complete
stories.summary: The U.S. military announced it has completed the withdrawal of all American troops from Iraq, ending a 12-year mission to fight the Islamic State group. The last troops left a northern Iraq air base under a Baghdad-Washington deal.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
stories.summary: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to raise a roughly $30 billion funding round that would value the company at $1.4 trillion. The report follows a week of product launches including GPT-6.1 Sol and new agent tools.

stories.title: OpenAI's latest features take direct aim at the app store model
stories.summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT with app-like interfaces, automations and plugin extensions that appear to bypass traditional app stores. It signals a push to make ChatGPT a distribution platform in its own right.

stories.title: Tesla secures $30B in new credit lines as it looks to scale Cybercab, Optimus
stories.summary: Tesla has secured about $30 billion in new credit lines as it looks to ramp production of the Cybercab robotaxi and Optimus humanoid robot. The financing gives the company capital for its next hardware bets.

stories.title: America.gov gets really weird when you ask it about Minecraft, but it's not a glitch
stories.summary: The U.S. government's America.gov AI assistant gives odd, unexpected answers on questions like Minecraft — behavior the site says is intentional rather than a bug. The trend highlights quirks in government-deployed AI assistants.

stories.title: Red Bull admits Max Verstappen's mysterious car issue cannot be fully fixed until 2027
stories.summary: Red Bull has acknowledged that a persistent issue limiting Max Verstappen's car this season cannot be fully resolved until the 2027 campaign. It means the reigning champion could spend the rest of 2026 racing with a known handicap.

stories.title: F1 approves shorter races for 2027 to fit revised power unit plan
stories.summary: F1 has approved shorter race distances for the 2027 season to accommodate a revised power unit plan. The change reshapes race strategy and is part of a broader evolution of F1's engine regulations.

stories.title: Carlos Sainz backs bold approach for Williams junior Will Green's racing future
stories.summary: Carlos Sainz has endorsed a bold development path for Williams junior Will Green as the team shapes its young driver programme. The backing points to a clear promotion route within Williams' F1 setup.

stories.title: Guenther Steiner predicts Max Verstappen will go winless in 2026 F1 season
stories.summary: Former Haas boss Guenther Steiner has predicted Max Verstappen will not win a race in the 2026 F1 season, citing Mercedes' and Kimi Antonelli's early dominance. It is a pointed call given Verstappen's championship pedigree.

stories.title: Steelers vs. Browns, Tuesday injury report ahead of Thursday Night Football
stories.summary: The Steelers and Browns released their second injury report ahead of Thursday Night Football, with updates on Jalen Ramsey, Joey Porter Jr., Brandin Echols and others. Player availability is a headline storyline for the AFC North matchup.

stories.title: See the top stories in Columbus on Wednesday, September 30
stories.summary: The Columbus Dispatch rounds up the top local stories for Wednesday, Sept. 30, including 18 Ohio counties under a state of emergency due to severe flooding. It's a one-stop look at what's moving in central Ohio today.

stories.title: Officer hospitalized after cruiser hit in Franklinton during traffic stop pursuit
stories.summary: A Columbus police officer was hospitalized and reported in stable condition after a traffic stop escalated into a pursuit that ended with the fleeing car hitting a cruiser in Franklinton. Two people were detained.
